h1: Custom Furniture Design & Manufacturing for Residential Interiors

blocks.text: Custom Furniture Design & Manufacturing for Residential Interiors

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) provides custom furniture design and manufacturing for apartments, residences, and private houses.

With more than 15 years of experience in custom furniture manufacturing, we create individual solutions that precisely match the architecture of the interior, dimensions of the space, functional requirements, and aesthetic preferences of each client.

We consider furniture an integral part of interior architecture. That is why kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, entrance hall furniture, home offices, storage systems, and other elements are designed as part of a cohesive interior concept.
Our furniture production is located in Slovakia, while our professional team provides delivery and installation for projects in different countries worldwide.
Custom Kitchens We design bespoke kitchens based on the dimensions of the space, floor plan, ergonomics, engineering requirements, and overall interior concept.
Every kitchen is developed specifically for the individual project — from cabinet configuration and work surfaces to internal organization, materials, hardware, and integrated lighting.
At the client's request, kitchens can also be equipped with Miele appliances as part of our partnership cooperation.
Custom Built-In Wardrobes Built-in wardrobes allow available space to be used efficiently while visually integrating storage into the architecture of the interior.
We design wardrobes to individual dimensions, taking into account required storage capacity, internal organization, opening mechanisms, materials, and front design.
Wardrobes can become an almost invisible part of the architecture or serve as a distinctive decorative feature of the interior.
Entrance Hall Furniture & Walk-In Closets We design custom entrance hall furniture and walk-in closet systems that provide convenient and well-organized storage for clothing, shoes, and accessories.
Shelves, drawers, hanging rails, pull-out elements, integrated lighting, and other functional components are carefully planned according to the client's needs.
Each storage system is adapted to the dimensions of the space and the individual requirements of its owners.
Custom Home Office Furniture For home offices, we design ergonomic desks, cabinets, shelving, storage systems, and integrated furniture compositions.
Special attention is given to workplace organization, convenient storage of documents and equipment, lighting, and the integration of furniture into the overall interior of the apartment or house.
Custom Furniture for Residential Interiors In addition to kitchens, wardrobes, and walk-in closets, DUMSKAYA DESIGN develops custom furniture solutions for different areas of the home.
These may include:
— living room furniture;
— TV units and wall panels;
— bedroom furniture;
— bedside tables and dressers;
— home libraries;
— children's room furniture;
— home workstations;
— built-in storage systems;
— decorative furniture structures.
Every element is designed according to the architecture of the space and the overall interior concept.
Individual Furniture Design The furniture design process begins with an analysis of the space, its dimensions, architecture, and the client's requirements.
We develop the furniture construction and determine dimensions, proportions, materials, internal organization, hardware, opening mechanisms, and decorative solutions.
When required, detailed technical drawings and specifications are prepared for manufacturing.
Materials & Hardware We select materials and components according to the design, functionality, operating conditions, and project budget.
Particular attention is given to the quality of fronts, cabinet structures, countertops, hardware, opening mechanisms, and internal fittings.
Modern manufacturing technologies make it possible to create custom furniture with complex geometry, integrated lighting, and carefully developed details.
Furniture as Part of Interior Design One of the key advantages of working comprehensively with DUMSKAYA DESIGN is the ability to develop the interior and custom furniture together.
This allows the dimensions and position of each element to be determined in advance and materials, colors, lighting, and architectural details to be coordinated within a single concept.
As a result, the furniture becomes a natural extension of the interior rather than a separate element added after the interior design has been completed.

Manufacturing, Delivery & Installation Once the project has been approved, the furniture proceeds to manufacturing. DUMSKAYA DESIGN furniture production is located in Slovakia. After manufacturing, delivery and professional installation at the client's property can be arranged. Our installation team works on projects in different countries, allowing us to implement custom furniture solutions not only in Slovakia and Austria but also for international projects.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — more than 15 years of experience in designing and manufacturing custom furniture for apartments and private houses.
